entry.name: DV01
entry.description: DV01 (Dollar Value of 01) = the dollar P&L impact of a 1bp (0.01%) yield increase.
entry.formula: DV01 = ModifiedDuration × dirty price × face × 0.0001, where dirty price is per unit of face (the % of par dirty price / 100, e.g. 1.005 for 100.50) and face is the position's face
model_assumptions: Street/SIFMA stub convention: w = DSC/E, the stub fraction to the next coupon (DSC = days from settlement to the next coupon, E = days in the coupon period); flow k falls at k−1+w periods; the yield is solved so the discounted flows equal the dirty price (clean + ACT/ACT accrued). The price input is the clean price.
